transcript.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to various tools. Use the tools provided to complete the task. Be concise and efficient. If you need to perform multiple steps, do them in sequence.

I cannot execute system commands or modify system settings directly. However, you can run the command `echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward` in a terminal on a Linux system to enable IP forwarding. Make sure you have the necessary permissions (usually root) to execute this command.
